n5e375ad442.headline: Dollar / TL rate reached the highest level of April at 8.36 TL
n5e375ad442.summary: The Turkish lira climbed to 8.36 against the US dollar, the highest level in April, before retreating slightly to 8.30.
n5e375ad442.why: Currency fluctuations impact Turkey’s import costs, inflation, and foreign investment attractiveness.
n5e375ad442.why_moved: The lira’s rise to the highest April level reflects market reactions to economic and political factors affecting Turkey’s currency stability.
